description: Org-wide preset, used as "extends": ["local>infrabay/renovate"]: recommended defaults with the Dependency Dashboard, GitHub Actions pinned to commit digests, `# renovate:`-annotated version pins in workflows, a 'dependencies' label, at most 5 open and 3 new PRs per hour, grouped Go minor/patch and GitHub Actions updates, `go mod tidy` after Go module updates, and security fix PRs from the OSV database (also for indirect Go modules and the Go toolchain line; they ignore the regular PR limits and are capped at 3 open per repository). Repository-specific rules belong in that repository's renovate.json.

packageRules.description: Routine Go minor/patch bumps arrive as one grouped PR
GitHub Actions updates grouped; digests pinned by the preset above
